Output

What is a Lorem Ipsum Generator?

Lorem Ipsum is placeholder text used by designers, developers, and publishers to fill space in layouts before final content is ready. It has been the industry standard since the 1500s and is derived from Cicero's De Finibus Bonorum et Malorum written in 45 BC.

Common Use Cases

Filling content areas in website mockups and wireframes
Testing typography and layout in UI designs
Placeholder content for email templates
Testing database fields and forms with realistic text length
Print layout and graphic design previews

Tips & Best Practices

💡Use paragraphs for body copy placeholders, sentences for captions, words for buttons and labels
💡The Classic Start option begins with the famous 'Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet' opening
💡Generate more paragraphs to test long-form content layouts

Frequently Asked Questions

What does Lorem Ipsum mean?▼
Lorem Ipsum is derived from Cicero's philosophical text and means roughly 'pain itself' in Latin. It was intentionally scrambled so it reads as random text without distracting from the design.
Why use Lorem Ipsum instead of real text?▼
Placeholder text prevents designers and reviewers from focusing on content instead of layout. It also avoids confidential or copyrighted content appearing in design mockups.
Is Lorem Ipsum Latin?▼
It is based on Latin but has been scrambled and is not grammatically correct Latin. It is simply used as realistic-looking dummy text.
